tools.name: list_file_uploads_skill_files
tools.title: List File Uploads Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the SEMOSS 'file-uploads' skill, the platform's guidance for attaching files to an LLM prompt and uploading files into an insight workspace. Call this when the user asks about file or image attachments, drag-and-drop or paste-to-upload, multipart uploads, sending a PDF or screenshot to a model, or the uploadInsight helper and the /api/uploadFile/baseUpload endpoint. Covers the two-step pattern (upload the bytes, then reference the returned fileLocation as a MEDIA part), the multipart field name, why Content-Type must not be set by hand, extension filtering, and retry handling. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for the LLM call itself (see the model skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The file-uploads skill (file-uploads). Always this value.

tools.name: read_file_uploads_skill_file
tools.title: Read File Uploads Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the SEMOSS 'file-uploads' skill in full, for writing code that uploads files and attaches them to a model call. Pass filePath exactly as list_file_uploads_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the upload request and its response shape, building the TEXT and MEDIA parts array, filtering by extension, error and retry handling, and where the reference implementation lives in the semoss-ui repo.

project.title: project
project.description: The file-uploads skill (file-uploads). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_file_uploads_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
